learned_equity_pilot.scope: Uniform-opponent equity feasibility only; no match-performance claim

simulator_throughput.scope: Direct official game, champion vs frozen range-aware configuration; excludes HTTP and process startup.

learned_equity_pilot.next_gate: No deployment without matched official match tests and range-conditioning compatibility.
learned_equity_pilot.timing_note: Median of three alternating-order passes over identical 1000 states. Model and label bytes unchanged. Separate simulator runs varied from 76 to 123 hands/s on this host.

champion_uniform_shrinkage.scope: Uniform equity with champion prior shrinkage at full 24/32/40/64 samples; excludes range conditioning and runtime sample halving.

learned_equity_pilot.timing_history_note: First three corrected passes retained from their recorded output; second batch added the champion uniform-shrinkage accuracy control. Predictor, inputs, and weights were unchanged; neither timing batch was discarded.

environment.timing_note: Sequential official HTTP matches. Background Chrome and Docker CPU activity was observed during one 1-second process snapshot; no causal attribution for timing variance is established. User applications were not stopped.

summary.note: CIs and verdicts are official per-match results. No pooled CI or new scoring formula is computed.

container.prerequisite: Run after the official tools/check_build.sh succeeds
